entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling because I think I need to return something? A helmet. The website was a bit much for me, I'm just so confused by it all.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... the color isn't right. My daughter picked it out, but it doesn't match my gear at all. The box is unopened, I never even took it out. I just don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you with this. I just need your order number to pull up the details.
Let me see... I have it here. It's VF-881-92B. I hope that's right. I'm never sure about these things.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the AeroSafe helmet. It was delivered 71 days ago. I'm glad to hear the box is still sealed. We take rider safety very seriously, so it's important you have gear you feel comfortable using.
So... is that too long? Did I miss the window? I just feel so overwhelmed by this.
Not at all. Our standard return policy is 90 days from the delivery date, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness. Really? So you can process it for me? That's such a relief.

Yes, I've already initiated the return for you. I just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. All you need to do is print it out, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Wow, okay. That's... that's much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Sarah.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
